a.xlink:title: Prerequisite header file for GROMACS build.
Declares the element performing first-order pressure coupling for the modular simulator.
This file declares functions for (mostly) the domdec module to use MPI functionality.
Declares enumerated types used throughout the code.
Declares the energy element for the modular simulator.
Provides the modular simulator algorithm.
Declares the state for the modular simulator.
Declares the main interfaces used by the modular simulator.
Declares special case of 3x3 matrix frequently used, and associated functions.
Provides the checkpoint data structure for the modular simulator.
Declares common exception classes and macros for fatal error handling.
Basic types and macros used throughout GROMACS.
Defines assert macros customized for Gromacs.
Declares real and related constants.
Declares a data structure for JSON-like structured key-value mapping.
Declares common string utility and formatting routines.
This file contains the definition of the microstate of the simulated system.

Declares gmx::HostAllocationPolicy, gmx::HostAllocator, gmx::HostVector and gmx::PaddedHostVector, which are used to make/be standard library containers that can allocate memory suitable for transfers. Currently the only supported transfers using pinned memory are to CUDA GPUs, but other possibilities exist in future.
Declares gmx::PaddedRVecVector.
Defines helper types for class enumerations.
Declares gmx::ArrayRefWithPadding that refers to memory whose size includes padding for SIMD operatio...
Provides ported functions/classes from gsl/pointers.
This file declares functions for inter-rank signalling by mdrun.
Declares StopHandler, a helper class and two stop conditions.
Declares gmx::ObservablesReducer and builder.
Declares the checkpoint helper for the modular simulator.
Declares the domain decomposition helper for the modular simulator.
Declares the free energy perturbation element for the modular simulator.
Declares the PME load balancing helper for the modular simulator.
Declares the signallers for the modular simulator.
Declares the topology class for the modular simulator.
Declares the trajectory element for the modular simulator.
This file contains the definition of a container for force buffers.
